+"""Smoke test for PL-01 (load_prices): runs end to end and checks the output's shape."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mdata.pipeline import load_prices
+from mdata.types import Prices
+
+CSV = (
+    "date,ticker,close\n"
+    "2024-03-01,ACME,100.0\n"
+    "2024-03-01,GLOBEX,50.0\n"
+    "2024-03-04,GLOBEX,50.5\n"
+    "2024-03-04,ACME,102.0\n"
+    "2024-03-05,ACME,99.0\n"
+    "2024-03-05,GLOBEX,\n"
+    "2024-03-06,ACME,97.5\n"
+    "2024-03-06,GLOBEX,51.2\n"
+)
+
+
+def _write(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(CSV)
+    return path
+
+
+def test_pl01_runs_end_to_end(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    prices = load_prices(_write(tmp_path))
+
+    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
+    assert prices.tickers == ("ACME", "GLOBEX")
+    assert set(prices.closes) == {"ACME", "GLOBEX"}
+    assert len(prices.dates) > 0
+    assert all(len(prices.closes[t]) == len(prices.dates) for t in prices.tickers)
+

+def test_pl01_ticker_filter_reaches_output(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    prices = load_prices(str(_write(tmp_path)), ["ACME"])
+
+    assert prices.tickers == ("ACME",)
+    assert len(prices.closes["ACME"]) == len(prices.dates)

    monkeypatch.setattr(vol_pipeline, "load_prices", fake.load_prices)
    return fake.CSV

    assert vol.returns.tickers == ("GLOBEX",)
    assert set(vol.values) == {"GLOBEX"}


def test_pl02_default_window_is_20(fake_csv) -> None:
    vol = vol_pipeline.vol_series(fake_csv)

    assert vol.window == 20
